_skill_years_help: Fill with YOUR real years per skill, e.g. {"React Native": 2.5, "React": 2.5, "Node.js": 1.5, "PostgreSQL": 1}. Screening questions like "years with <skill>" are only answered from this map — 93 past applications stalled on them. Leave a skill out to have the bot hand that question to you.
_current_ctc_help: current_ctc is empty, so every "current CTC" question is handed to you (~60 past stalls). Fill e.g. "6.5 LPA" to let the bot answer it.
_direct_apply_help: Employer ATS forms (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby) most often stall on: linkedin_url, current_location (e.g. "Hyderabad, Telangana"), current_ctc, skill_years, and essay questions. custom_answers is a list of {"match": "<regex on the question>", "answer": "<your words>"}, e.g. {"match": "reason for (job )?change", "answer": "..."} — the bot never writes these for you. consents.privacy_and_terms=true lets it tick required privacy-notice / terms checkboxes; leave false to review each yourself. Demographic questions are left blank, or 'decline to answer' when required.
